governance.attested_by: ercot46 clock-unification + ST_GAS realism keeper-candidate gate, session 2026-07-08 (full scored bundle; stepwise A/B/C attribution; owner sign-off pending)
governance.note: Two-part round on the ercot42 keeper recipe: (1) CLOCK UNIFICATION — the CPT->CST placement-defect fix (builders merged PR #1725) rebuilt onto the measured ORDC-reserves (NP6-905), AS withholding/by-restype-storage (NP3-911/60-day), and WTX-congestion (NP6-86) parquets, plus rule-23 re-derives of the WS-A RTOLCAP_FWD shares/deliverability and the WTX curtailment share table/depth pair (all verified pure -1h DST-month placement shifts, r=1.00000 vs the pre-fix parquets, January identity). (2) ST_GAS REALISM — gas_st_netload_drag (the CAMPD overnight-CF-vs-net-load reliability floor, FROZEN coefficients, docs/ercot-st-gas-netload-drag-2026-06.md) + gas_st_startup_cost (ST_GAS_COMMITMENT_PARAMS startup/min-run/min-down markup, constants.py, NREL/SR-5500-55433) so ST_GAS holds its overnight minimum and pays a real stop-start cost instead of cycling like a peaker (rule 18: gates on unit physics, not a class-name tuple). STEPWISE ATTRIBUTION (A=ercot44b control byte-faithful replay on pre-fix data / B=ercot45 clock-unified, data-only delta / C=ercot46, this bundle, B + ST_GAS mechanisms): B isolates the clock effect (a discovered C3a-2023 CAVEAT->FAIL compensation, registered per rule 14, not tuned); C isolates the ST_GAS mechanism effect on top — ST_GAS under-run closes 2024 -5.96->-1.33 TWh, 2025 -4.31->-0.39 TWh (68-91% closure), 2023 mildly overshoots to +2.19 TWh (still C1 PASS, well inside the 8 TWh/2% band); COAL_PRB over-run improves ~1 TWh/yr (not fully absorbed - CC_REGULAR gives back the balance, matching the original derivation's conservation finding); C3a mean-LMP improves in every year with no LOYO-held-out degradation (rule 22): 2023 FAIL->CAVEAT +9.3%, 2024 CAVEAT +6.5%, 2025 CAVEAT->PASS +4.9%. C3b/C3c (the scarcity tail) are UNCHANGED by this round by design - a separate offer-formation round owns them (docs/handoffs/ercot-g22-demand-side-design-2026-07.md §5). D-2/D-4/D-1 (legitimacy_diagnostics.json, this bundle): st_netload_drag clears D-4 cleanly (0% off-window binding all 3 years - the declared all-hours window, scripts/legitimacy_diagnostics.py D4_WINDOWS, matches the CAMPD evidence that ST_GAS is committed every day and night, never fully off). ST_GAS forced share 26.6%/34.0%/32.6% (2023/24/25) - 2023 clears the 30% merchant cap outright; 2024/25 escalate to rubric-v2.2 GROUNDED PASS (D-4 clean + D-1 profile_r 0.97-0.99 / cv_ratio 1.35-1.58, both clearing gates) per the owner's 2026-07-07 amendment: forcing past the budget is legitimate when the mechanism is structurally grounded and shape-faithful. Zero-forcing ablation twin registered alongside (ercot46_clock_steamgas_ablation, ALL merchant floors off per D-3/MECH_ABLATION_FIELDS - reliability_floor, ct_netload_drag, gas_st_netload_drag, ra_mustoffer_bridge, ercot_wtx_curtailment_driver - not an ST_GAS-isolated counterfactual): C3a price mean blows up +117%/+163%/+52% and ST_GAS reverts past its pre-mechanism under-run (-4.02/-8.69/-6.12 TWh, deeper than the A/B baseline because reliability_floor and the WTX driver also touch the class), confirming the floor stack collectively carries real structural weight, not a cosmetic fit. gas_st_startup_cost is NOT in the D-3 min-gen-floor registry (it is a P1 bid-markup, not a forced-energy floor) so it stays ON in the ablation by design - the ablation isolates FORCED ENERGY, not commitment-cost pricing. Discovered compensations registered, not tuned (rule 14): C3a-2023 CAVEAT->FAIL in B, partially recovered by C to CAVEAT (+9.3% vs A's +8.9%) - open root-cause item, no coefficient moved; C5c-2024 storage monthly-shape r degrades across the round (A 0.481 -> B 0.452 -> C 0.409, all FAIL) - the corrected renewable/net-load shape re-couples storage arbitrage timing, an open root-cause item, no coefficient moved. Everything else is the ercot42 stack unchanged; no scalar re-tuned against a residual this round (rules 1/13/20/23/26).

exceptions.reason: Inherited ercot42 limitation: 2025 preliminary EIA-923 vintage (9/41 CC_REGULAR, 24/38 CT_PEAKER, 12/22 ST_GAS plants missing) - no trustworthy per-class actual, family falls back to the EIA-930 aggregate. Re-score when the final 923 vintage lands.

DISCOVERED COMPENSATION (rule 14, registered not tuned): the corrected ORDC-reserves/AS/WTX clock data alone (arm B) flips this year from ercot42's +8.9% CAVEAT to +10.0% FAIL - a genuinely new regression from the placement-defect fix, not present pre-fix. The ST_GAS mechanism (arm C) partially recovers it to +9.3% CAVEAT, still short of A's +8.9%. Root-cause open: which corrected series (ORDC reserves, AS withholding, or WTX congestion) drives the 2023 mean-price residual has not been isolated to a single builder; no coefficient was moved in response to this finding.

DISCOVERED COMPENSATION (rule 14, registered not tuned): degrades across the round from ercot42's r=0.518 (A: 0.481, B: 0.452, C: 0.409) - the corrected renewable-potential shape re-couples storage arbitrage timing away from the actual monthly discharge pattern. Open root-cause item; storage dispatch parameters were not touched this round.

exceptions.magnitude: +2.19 TWh, share +0.5pp (PASS, well within the 8 TWh/2% band)
exceptions.reason: Report-only note, not a caveat: the ST_GAS drag mildly overshoots in 2023 alone (2024/2025 undershoot, closing 68-91% of the prior gap) - the mild-weather year has lower net-load, so the same frozen curve produces less headroom for CC_REGULAR give-back. Watch in future re-derives; the curve is frozen against residuals (rule 23) and was not adjusted.
